description: Aider-polyglot style (JavaScript): implement a token-bucket rate limiter with an injected clock from a stub and an instructions file - fractional refill that survives failed calls, a capacity clamp with no banking of idle time, waitTime rounded up and Infinity beyond capacity, a clock that may go backwards, and argument validation with specific error types. The node:test suite is the acceptance bar and the post-turn verifier gives a repair round with the test output, like aider's second try.
